*Hetugocchaka* (Patthana 20.1) is a text within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and final book of the Abhidhamma Piṭaka in the Theravāda Tipiṭaka. The title refers to the "cluster on root conditions" (*hetu*), an analytical group of dyads (*duka*) stemming from the Abhidhamma matrix (*mātikā*). The secondary literature passages matched in the dossier do not directly examine this specific *Paṭṭhāna* section, as all retrieved excerpts treat the homonymous *Hetugocchaka* section of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī*.

 However, DharmaNexus detects extensive internal Pali text reuse, identifying 748 matching passages shared with 93 other Pali texts, predominantly within other sections of the *Paṭṭhāna* [DharmaNexus]. Its largest textual overlaps occur with *Hetuduka, Tika* (Patthana 3.1; 77 matches, longest §3.1_0–4.1_1 ↔ §273.1–278.1) and *Hetuduka, Duka* (Patthana 6.1; 78 matches, longest §11.1–17.1 ↔ §105.1–111.1), alongside major correspondences with *Tika Hetuduka* (Patthana 4.1), *Hetugocchaka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 3.2), *Hetuduka, Sahetukadukādi* (Patthana 12.1), and *Hetugocchaka* (Patthana 2.1) [DharmaNexus]. Outside Pali literature, DharmaNexus automatically aligns two passages with the Tibetan translation of the *Āryasaṃdhinirmocanasūtravyākhyāna* (D4358-2; best plausibility score 25, §15.1 ↔ §139a-5–139a-10), though this machine alignment is not corroborated as an established historical parallel [DharmaNexus].
